text:
maya: Heads-up — I prototyped an 'auto-fallback sentinel' UX. Want quick feedback on degrade modes, triggers, and audit playback.
dom: Can you drop the figma link or a quick gif?
maya: https://figma.com/proto/xyz (mock). Core idea: 'sentinel' is a lightweight watcher that can apply a degrade mode automatically + bind a sampling/audit policy.
kevin: Quick Q — how is this different from our existing autofallback policies? Triggers, granularity?
maya: Sentinel sits before full policy rollouts. It watches error_rate, latency p95, and quality regressions. When thresholds hit it picks one of three modes: gentle-sampling, quiet-fallback, or full-redirect. Each mode has independent audit sampling and TTL.
sarah: For gentle-sampling do we still bill at full token cost? Need to track cost impact in the UI.
dom: Ideally gentle-sampling routes 90% to cheaper variant (quantized) and 10% to golden model for audit. So unit-token costs differ; we should show the delta.
james: ops-bot: deploy-preview for sentinel feature finished — logs: `autofallback/sentinel: initialized` :white_check_mark:
maya: UX ask: add a 'replay sampled requests' button in console that replays a snippet against the golden model and shows diffs. Concerns?
kevin: Good, but we must have a PII scrubber for replays. Replaying raw user content is risky. Add a checkbox: redact PHI/PII before replay.
sarah: +1 on redact. Also automatic audit TTL: audits older than X days auto-redact or drop. Need policy defaults.
dom: Also add an operator 'snooze' action for sentinel so infra can pause auto-fallback for N minutes while debugging.
maya: Proposed minimal policy snippet for config preview in console:
```
sentinel:
  trigger: error_rate>0.05
  degrade_mode: gentle-sampling
  sample_rate: 0.1
  fallback_model: "gptq-13b"
  audit_ttl_days: 30
  scrub: true
```
kevin: Love it. Also require a safety gating: only enable auto-redirect for routes with a canary or pre-authorized fallback list. Don't let any route redirect to arbitrary models.
maya: Yep — add an allowlist per-route and a toggle for 'require manual approval for redirect' in advanced settings.
sarah: We should surface estimated cost delta + latency impact before enabling sentinel on a route.
dom: I'll wire up a small cost-pricing calc that uses token mix and model profiles.
maya: UX follow-up: show top 3 reasons a sentinel triggered (error spike, latency, quality drift) with links into trace and eval sets.
kevin: Also log an event to rollout-audit as: `sentinel.triggered -> {route, mode, metrics, sample_id}` for playback.
ops-bot: alert: rollout-audit index created in staging.
maya: Final ask — can someone pair on masking logic for replay? @kevin @sarah
sarah: I can tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
dom: Leaving notes in the figma comments and a small task in the board. :eyes:
maya: Thanks everyone — I'll update the mock and add a cost/latency preview by EOD.
